skill.summary: Provides summaries and analysis of public short videos and topics from Kuaibao/QQ Kankan for keyword, account, and trending list data.

latestVersion.changelog:
kuaibao-video-hot-trend 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for 天天快报/QQ看点短视频公开短视频与话题分析
- Supports keyword/topic-based video retrieval and summary (likes/comments/favorites)
- Enables comparison of video performance for user homepages
- Provides leaderboards and category statistics for trending videos
- Designed for light, compliant analysis—no downloads or API reverse engineering
- All data extracted from public pages only, intended for internal insights and alerts
